# Fail-on values

`--fail-on` makes a command exit 3 when its report has a match. The report is still written. A list flag takes several values, comma-separated or repeated.

| Command | Value | Matches |
|---|---|---|
| [tfcensus audit backend](/cli/audit/backend) | `info` | worth knowing, no risk |
| [tfcensus audit backend](/cli/audit/backend) | `low` | small risk |
| [tfcensus audit backend](/cli/audit/backend) | `medium` | fix soon |
| [tfcensus audit backend](/cli/audit/backend) | `high` | fix now |
| [tfcensus drift](/cli/drift) | `drift` | any unit drifted |
| [tfcensus drift](/cli/drift) | `drift:reverts` | a full plan would revert drift |
| [tfcensus drift](/cli/drift) | `errors` | a unit failed |
| [tfcensus scan](/cli/scan) | `unmanaged` | no state manages it |
| [tfcensus scan](/cli/scan) | `double-managed` | more than one state manages it |
| [tfcensus whois](/cli/whois) | `unmanaged` | no state manages it |
| [tfcensus whois](/cli/whois) | `double-managed` | more than one state manages it |
